title: No effects of single-session concurrent tDCS on explicit motor sequence learning in healthy adults with conventional 2 mA and tangential 6 mA currents
title_zh: 单次会话并行 tDCS 对健康成年人明确运动序列学习无显著影响：常规 2 mA 和切向 6 mA 电流
abstract: BACKGROUND: Conflicting reports regarding the efficacy of transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) for motor sequence learning have limited its translation into clinical practice. We conducted this study to systematically resolve these inconsistencies. METHODS: We performed two randomized, double-blind, between-subject experiments (N=143 total) with an explicit motor sequence learning task in healthy participants. Experiment 1 tested high-definition (HD) tDCS with tangential current flow to the primary motor cortex (M1); Experiment 2 replicated conventional M1-SO radial stimulation. To ensure experimental rigor, we utilized blinded experimental and analysis procedures, pre-planned statistical comparisons, and baseline typing speed controls to mitigate confounding variability. RESULTS: Both experiments yielded null results. Tangential HD-tDCS demonstrated no polarity-specific effect on motor learning, even at the strongest intensity contrast tested to date (+6 mA versus -6 mA). Similarly, conventional 2 mA M1-SO stimulation did not significantly differ from sham. CONCLUSION: These findings, together with a survey of the existing literature, suggest that the effects of single-session concurrent tDCS on explicit motor sequence learning are not robust across studies. Our results underscore the necessity of rigorous methodological controls to prevent false discoveries in neuromodulation research.
abstract_zh: 背景：关于经颅直流电刺激 (tDCS) 在运动序列学习中疗效的报道不一，限制了其临床应用。本研究旨在系统地解决这些不一致性。方法：我们进行了两项随机、双盲、受试者间实验（总 N=143），采用明确的运动序列学习任务，在健康参与者中进行。实验 1 测试高定向 (HD) tDCS，电流切向流向初级运动皮层 (M1)；实验 2 复制常规 M1-SO 径向刺激。为确保实验严谨性，我们采用了盲实验和分析程序、预先计划的统计比较，以及基线打字速度控制，以减少混杂变异的影响。结果：两项实验均未发现显著效果。切向 HD-tDCS 在测试过的最大强度对比下（+6 mA 与 -6 mA）均未表现出极性特异性对运动学习的影响。同样，常规 2 mA M1-SO 刺激与假刺激相比无显著差异。结论：这些发现结合现有文献综述，表明单次会话并行 tDCS 对明确运动序列学习的影响在研究间并不稳健。我们的结果强调了严谨方法控制在神经调控研究中防止假发现的必要性。
